Overview

The hidden cost of Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Technology & SaaS is never the model; it is the scaffolding — data contracts, evaluation harnesses, rollback machinery, audit evidence. We price and build that scaffolding explicitly, on product analytics, because that is where programs actually succeed or die. The architecture reflects all three from the first commit.
